name: morph-popover
title: Morph popover
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A surface shared with the trigger grows into a non-modal panel. Escape and an outside pointer close it.

meta.descriptionEs: Una superficie compartida con el disparador crece hasta un panel no modal. Escape y un puntero afuera lo cierran.

api.name: label / title
api.description: Trigger label and optional panel name.

api.name: children
api.description: Panel content. Tab may leave the popover.

docs: Clean-room shared-element popover using motion layoutId. Blendy is the behavior reference only and is not a dependency. aria-modal is false. Reduced motion fades the panel in place. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
